correctness.rationale: Four-dimensional hyperbolic Laplacian yields the exact radial factor (1-l|x|^2/(l+2)); spherical degree multiplicity is (l+1)^2. The exact radial Toeplitz eigenvalue quotient transforms to the positive density (1-s/l)^(l+1)s^(p-1)(s+2)^2 on [0,l]. Dominated convergence gives a normalized three-gamma mixture, uniform in l/N away from zero; weighted Riemann sums give the three-scale spectral weak limit and continuous threshold counts. Small and large collar coefficients follow from explicit power and integrable exponential tail; \(p=1\) polynomial integration yields \(15837/800\). A self-contained checker passed 54 supplementary numerical assertions; no finite checks are presented as an infinite proof.
